posts.subject: Player collision on knife.
posts.bodyHtml:
There is a problem with player collison mentioned by @KnAWLeDGE
The problem is that you can boost on map textures at some maps ( Not all ) but you can boost if you have a friend in opposite team and they stand on other people heads and run boost or 3 man boosts are aviable now.

I dont see the problem, camping is not allowed and there isnt a big advantage if you boost somewhere up.


But maybe i m wrong, how about adding the rule, that you are not allowed to work together with opponents ?


it could solve the 'problem'



Greetz ifZ4ne

In my opinion, adding a rule like that would solve the problem "temporarily".
Meaning, it would work, as long as there is an admin on the server.


If this happens during the morning hours when there are only 10 players and no admin online, delaying like that (or even bugusing and jumping out of the map) is not going to be affected by any rule.


How about just reverting the player collision? @Sky @BlackFire

I just edited the rules for now as I saw certain sense in changing the way player collision works.
It's the same like with the 2vs1 rule, camping etc. - players themselves have to check on each other and in case of someone breaking the rules, call an admin, voteban or screen the issue and post it on the forum.


We'll just see how it works out and affects the experience on the knife server for now.


/Close
